correctness.rationale: The ensemble identity makes the claim equivalent to concavity of \(g_c\). The radial Hessian is positive definite on the open Bloch ball, and the Schur complement reduces the condition to \(Q_c\). Direct determinant expansion gives the stated threshold. The series bound \(\delta\ge1/3\) and the limiting family \( (X,Y,Z)=(s-Z,0,Z)\), with \(Z\downarrow0\), prove sufficiency and sharpness. Nonconcavity for any \(c>c_*\) yields a finite two-state counterexample by a local symmetric perturbation.
